items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I used to play a lot of dancing for him at Poisevere and Hall of Economy, Incorporated, and so forth. What was his name? Ernest Delaro.

ctx.x: Well he might have made money on that deal. Well he did. Was he a friend of Buddy's or something? No he was a friend of mine. He put up the money, huh? Oh yeah.
I used to play a lot of dancing for him at Poisevere and Hall of Economy, Incorporated, and so forth. What was his name? Ernest Delaro. He died some time back in Chicago.
Does his family play music any of them? No he wasn't a musician.
